# DA2 Small geometry tests

The landscape/portrait/thin-image and unpadding scenarios in `src/depth_geometry_tests.rs` adapt Duecki's GPL-3.0-or-later tests from CalibRaw `2466ca6662c3fd1e901377c0450b19f5f96d3e85`, `crates/calibraw-ai/src/ai_masks/depth.rs`. The licence is retained in `CalibRaw-GPL-3.0.txt`.

`channel-mean.onnx` is an original test-only graph generated by `generate.py`: input `[1,3,518,518]`, output `[1,518,518]`, RGB-channel mean. It has no learned weights and is never used by the app. Tests call the unchanged production DA2 Small preprocessing/unpadding function with this deterministic graph, so they exercise actual tensor placement and cropping without downloading a model. Existing map polarity and resized dimensions remain unchanged.

Model-quality tests, robust normalization, invalid-output handling, and new models remain outside this test-only change. This is not evidence of DA2 Small's segmentation quality.
